authority_statement: All FAE features and product surfaces must be designed around the Mining Authored Reference identity. Earlier Direction D, Direction D+, VL-08 and exploratory studies remain historical/provenance evidence only; they are not implementation targets.

propagation_rule.principle: Translate the authored identity to each feature's function; do not clone Mining layout mechanically.
preserve: authored intentional composition rather than generic SaaS/crypto-dashboard patterns
green only for confirmed/received/safe semantic state
every visible element must feel intentional, not generated
propagation_rule.feature_specific_adaptation: Each feature may change density, hierarchy, motion and controls to match its function, but must remain recognizably authored by the same visual system.

non_effects: does not alter wallet cryptography/address formats/transaction semantics
does not authorize public deployment or release
does not authorize canonical main merge
